svg.title: MATCHES ARE NOT FOR CHILDREN!! - BC Forest Service F.P.19 reconstruction
svg.desc: Revision 4: recomposed vector paint fields and material, plus a manually reconstructed broken match junction and tapered splinters at the child hips. Revision 3 curved white edges are retained; custom headline and fitted seal remain editable. Photo-mask overlays are diagnostic only. No embedded raster image or photo contour tracing. Colours fit the supplied photograph; original print dimensions and inks remain unverified. The 1000 by 1400 artboard is an estimated registration plane.
